stem: What happens next in this passage after “Open drinks and half-eaten food are not allowed.”?
options: She did not win first place, but many people remembered her speech.
The old bridge no longer does its first job, but it still connects people.
The fridge helped people, but only because volunteers built trust through rules.
At first, some people worried that the fridge would become dirty or empty.
